title: Measurement of Organic Porosity for Shale Sample
author: Fangwen Chen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iczcax6

steps.title: Measure Hydrocarbon Transformation Ratios
steps.instruction: Measure the transformation ratios of hydrocarbon generated from organic matter as temperature increases using a low mature shale sample.

steps.title: Measure Bulk Densities
steps.instruction: Determine the bulk density of the shale sample (ρ b) and the bulk density of the kerogen (ρ kerogen), both in cm³/g.

substeps.instruction: Measure bulk density of shale sample ρ b (cm 3 /g)
Measure bulk density of kerogen ρ kerogen (cm 3 /g)

steps.title: Calculate Transformation Ratios
steps.instruction: Calculate the transformation ratios F ( R o ) (%) of hydrocarbon generated from organic matter of the shale sample by combining the burial and thermal history.

steps.title: Restore Original Organic Indices
steps.instruction: Restore the original hydrogen index I H0 and the original total organic carbon w (TOC 0 ) (%) of the shale sample.

steps.title: Analyze Pore Correction Coefficient
steps.instruction: Analyze the organic pore correction coefficient C of the shale sample.

steps.title: Calculate Organic Porosity
steps.instruction: Calculate the organic porosity Ф organic (%) of the shale sample using the formula: Ф organic = w (TOC 0 ) · I H0 · F ( R o ) · ( ρ b / ρ kerogen ) · C / 1000
